mapper.select: SELECT u.id AS u_id, u.nickname AS u_nickname, u.avatarUrl AS u_avatarUrl, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime from t_article a, t_user u where a.userId = u.id and a.deleteState = 0 order by a.createTime desc

SELECT u.id AS u_id, u.nickname AS u_nickname, u.avatarUrl AS u_avatarUrl, a.id, a.boardId, a.userId, a.title, a.visitCount, a.replyCount, a.likeCount, a.state, a.createTime, a.updateTime from t_article a, t_user u where a.userId = u.id and a.deleteState = 0 and a.boardId = #{boardId} order by a.createTime desc
